hypothesis: In the honey bee Apis mellifera, the queen (Aristotle's 'king') is the mother of both workers and new queens.
pass_criterion: Pre-registered. SUPPORTS if a downloaded microsatellite genotype table for Apis mellifera labels both workers and queen-caste females (queen, gyne, or queen cell) from the same colonies, and a single diploid maternal genotype is compatible with at least 80 percent of workers and at least 80 percent of queen-caste females in more than half of the colonies that contain at least 5 workers and at least 3 queen-caste females. Compatibility: at every scored locus the offspring carries at least one allele of the mother. If the table includes an observed queen genotype, that genotype is the mother; otherwise the mother is reconstructed as a diploid genotype compatible with the offspring.
fail_criterion: Pre-registered. REFUTES if every colony that meets the sample-size floor has no diploid maternal genotype compatible with both at least one worker and at least one queen-caste female, or an observed queen genotype is excluded at one or more loci for every worker or for every queen-caste female. MIXED if the maternal genotype is compatible with one caste in a majority of qualifying colonies but not the other, or if every obtainable table contains only one of the two castes (that caste's maternity can be scored, the other is untested). INCONCLUSIVE with reason data-unavailable if no genotype table can be downloaded; reason underpowered if no colony meets the sample-size floor.

test_contract.expected_observation: In honey-bee colonies, one diploid mother is genetically compatible with both worker females and queen-caste females.
test_contract.disconfirming_observation: Workers and queen-caste females in the same colonies require different mothers, or an observed queen is excluded as the mother of one of those castes.
test_contract.admissible_datasets: Open microsatellite genotypes of Apis mellifera that identify colony and caste. Cape-bee thelytoky experiments that deliberately replace the queen with an unrelated queen are not used as the worker-maternity test. A natural-history account is admissible only for the mixed, one-caste case, and only as prose the script matches, not as a substitute for genotypes when genotypes exist.
test_contract.inference_method: Per colony and locus, a maternal diploid genotype is compatible when every offspring of a caste shares at least one allele with it. The pre-registered thresholds are 80 percent of each caste and a majority of colonies with at least 5 workers and 3 queen-caste females.

interpretation: The claim file maps Aristotle's 'kings' (leaders of the hive) to honey-bee queens. 'Generate both their own kind and the bees' is read as maternity of new queens and of workers. It is not read as exclusive maternity: worker-laid males or occasional worker-laid females do not refute the claim that the queen produces both castes. Drones are outside the claim.
